newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to inject reserves into the banking system via a round of overnight system repurchase agreements Wednesday, analysts said.

Federal funds opened at 5-9/16 percent and have since eased to 5-7/16 percent, but remain tight, suggesting there is an add need Wednesday -- the final day of the Fed's two-week maintenance reserve period.
"Since Monday's three-day system repo was not fixed, some banks will withdraw collateral early," said analysts at UBS Securities LLC.
